text: The room was quiet, clean, and close to the station. Staff helped us store our bags after checkout.
Breakfast was limited but the bed was comfortable. The shower took a minute to warm up.
Check-in took fifteen minutes and our street-facing room was noisy on Friday night.
Good location for the museum. The room looked like the photos, although the pillows were too soft for me.
We stayed two nights. Housekeeping replaced the towels, and the front desk arranged an early taxi.
The lift is small and slow. Everything else was practical for a short business trip.
Our family room had enough space for four people. The pool area became crowded in the afternoon.
Wi-Fi worked reliably at the desk. I could hear doors closing in the hallway before midnight.
The apartment kitchen had basic cookware and a full-size fridge. Grocery shops were a short walk away.
Reception corrected a billing error promptly. Parking cost extra, which was clear in the booking details.
